incident-bot: :rotating_light: Automated alert: spike in 5xx (502/504) and gateway timeouts observed across inference-gateway in us-west-2. Error rate 7x baseline over the last 3m. Auto-created thread and paged oncall.
Alice Nguyen: grabbing this — I'm oncall. seeing a cluster of errors tied to cache lookup failures (kv-shard read errors).
Marco Diaz: same. dashboards show a correlated surge in prefix-miss rate + backend DB read latency for keys served by kv-shard-17 and kv-shard-18.
Priya Iyer: interesting — telemetry shows sudden evictions on those shards and a small number of corrupted prefix checksums before the evictions. could be a rolling GC/compaction bug.
Alice Nguyen: customer impact? Jason, any reports?
Jason Cole: CS queue has ~4 customers reporting autocomplete timeouts and some 502s for embedding endpoints. nothing customer-wide yet but one mid-market customer is seeing % of requests fail.
Marco Diaz: stack traces from gateway show downstream 5xx returned when runtime tries to fetch KV prefix and gets a 500 from cache-proxy. Logs: `cache-proxy: Error reading entry: checksum mismatch for prefix abc123` repeated.
Priya Iyer: good catch. I can query the KV nodes. running: `for n in shard-17 shard-18; do ssh $n \"sudo journalctl -u cache-proxy | tail -n 200\"; done`
Priya Iyer: output has repeated `Eviction: reclaiming 32k entries` and `Checksum mismatch: prefix_metadata` lines.
Alice Nguyen: likely corrupt prefix index causing retrievals to fail and fallback code path to synchronous DB, which is saturating DB and causing timeouts.
Marco Diaz: mitigation plan: 1) divert traffic off affected shards -> soft shard pinning to healthy shards 2) enable DB-fallback throttling/circuit-breaker to protect DB 3) roll affected cache nodes into maintenance (restart and rebuild) 4) update status page. Anyone object?
Jason Cole: do we have safe routing rule to pin traffic?
Priya Iyer: yes, in routing we can set a policy to prefer shard pools a,b,c and mute shard-17/18 for 30m. I'll prepare the change.
Alice Nguyen: Marco, can you toggle the circuit-breaker for db reads? We need to drop sync fallbacks to 10% for now.
Marco Diaz: doing it now: `curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $SRE_TOKEN\" https://control-plane/ops/circuit-breakers/db-read -d '{\"fallback_rate\":0.1}'` -> response OK.
deploy-bot: deploy started: route-policy-update v2026.3 -> targeting gateway routing service (canary 10% -> 100%).
Priya Iyer: initiating routing change to exclude shard-17/18 from hot-path. Patch applied to control plane, canary at 20% for 60s.
Alice Nguyen: monitoring error rate and latency.
(30s pass)
Alice Nguyen: canary looks good — error rate from 7x -> 2x, DB RPS dropped by ~40%. proceeding to ramp to 100%.
deploy-bot: route-policy-update v2026.3 -> applied to 100%.
Marco Diaz: starting maintenance on shard-17: restarting cache-proxy and kicking off index verification. command: `systemctl restart cache-proxy && /opt/redwood/bin/prefix_verify --repair`
Priya Iyer: note: prefix_verify has a safe mode that rebuilds only suspect buckets. running in safe mode first. output shows ~0.6% corrupted prefixes; repair will rehydrate from primary store.
Alice Nguyen: good. moving shard-18 to maintenance next.
Jason Cole: updating customers: posting to status — intermittent request failures affecting specific features; work in progress.
Jason Cole: Status update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-129 (brief note + mitigation steps).
Alice Nguyen: escalation: opening a postmortem placeholder and tagging product/security for potential data integrity concerns.
SRE Rotation Bot: handoff scheduled to Nina at 04:00 UTC. Nina, you're on next.
Nina (oncall): acknowledged. I'll review the repair logs and coordinate DB health checks.
Marco Diaz: after repair, we need to run a rolling consistency check across all kv-shards to ensure no other latent corruption. scheduling scan job `kv-scan --window 3h` during low-traffic.
Priya Iyer: agree. also suggestion: increase prefix TTL and slow eviction aggressiveness for 24h, gives time for repairs and reduces churn. I'll push a config change proposal.
Alice Nguyen: owner/timeline: I'm owning incident until handoff. immediate mitigation done (traffic routed off bad shards, circuit-breaker applied). Next steps: finish repairs, run global scan, validate customer impacts, create postmortem.
Jason Cole: notifying affected customers with update + ETA to full resolution ~3-4 hours.
Priya Iyer: repair on shard-17 completed — repaired 1,248 corrupted prefixes, rewarming cache from source store.
Marco Diaz: shard-18 repair started. DB load stable.
Alice Nguyen: all right. I'm going to update this thread and then handoff at 04:00 UTC. Great job. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident SEV2: mitigated (routing bypass + circuit-breaker). Monitoring continues.
Nina (oncall): I have the logs and will continue monitoring for 2h post-handoff.
Alice Nguyen: handoff to Nina complete. I'll drop follow-up notes in postmortem draft.
Marco Diaz: follow-up action items: - run `kv-scan` global - add stricter checks for prefix checksum at write time - add alert if eviction rate > 3x baseline for a shard - playbook update for shard maintenance
Jason Cole: will coordinate customer comms + add a note to the incident timeline.
Priya Iyer: pushing config change to reduce eviction aggressiveness (tentative): `eviction.policy=conservative`, `min-resident=5%` — will monitor memory pressure.
Alice Nguyen: last on-call status: monitoring shows error rate back to baseline, DB stable, customers acknowledged update. closing live mitigation phase.
incident-bot: Logged incident actions: routing change v2026.3, circuit-breaker change, shard repair operations. Please file postmortem when ready.
